rationale: Hardings Group (Tas) is a direct Ulverstone civil construction company running a paid Certificate III Civil Construction traineeship for 2027.
Explicitly aimed at school leavers with full on-the-job training; White Card and driver's licence are the only firm requirements.
Civil construction, road works and asphalt/bituminous surfacing overlap Marc's civil coursework, though this is trade-level, not engineering.
caution: Re-scored by Claude: Certificate III trade traineeship for school leavers, below an Advanced Diploma holder, relocation to Tasmania.
gaps: Trade-level (Cert III) traineeship, not an engineering role
title: Civil Construction Traineeship
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
Do you hold a Construction Induction Safety certificate (White Card)?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
Are you willing to undergo a pre-employment medical check?
Do you have a current Australian driver's licence?
